Package de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map

Class IndestructibleWall

java.lang.Object
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.GameObject
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.Wall
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.IndestructibleWall
All Implemented Interfaces:
Drawable
public class IndestructibleWall extends Wall
The IndestructibleWall class represents a type of wall in the BomberQuest game that cannot be destroyed by explosions or other interactions.

This class extends the Wall class and provides specific behaviors and attributes for indestructible walls, including creating a static hitbox and rendering the appropriate texture.

Features

  • Defines the indestructible wall's position on the game map.
  • Creates a static hitbox using the Box2D physics engine for collision handling.
  • Renders the wall with a unique texture.
